status: Proposed for discussion; not approved or implemented
direction: Purple, red and teal Roblox stud UI with prominent square relief and chunky outlined display typography

roles.purple: Main window backgrounds and all item cards; deeper and lighter purple values establish depth
roles.red: Window title bars and close controls
roles.teal: Primary actions, selection and equipped states; lighter teal is an accent within the same hue family
roles.text: Warm ivory for main text; pale lavender for secondary text; dark ink for outlines

display.style: Normal; genuine heavy display face, no synthetic bold, no wide tracking or italics
display.outline: 2px dark outside stroke on large text; 1.5px on card labels; crisp 2px downward shadow

interface.outline: No outline on small copy; place it on a solid recessed surface

fontVerification.method: Read installed Roblox content/fonts/families JSON, inspected font name tables and embedded those exact local TrueType files; no external font dependency in preview

treatments: Square 12px raised studs on a 25px pitch across backplates, title bars, detail panel and swatches
9px studs on 21px pitch within compact item cards
Stud top and left edges are lit; right and bottom edges are dark with a crisp offset shadow
Default stud strength 0.72, increased from 0.17; no blurred glow
2–3px dark panel borders, 1–2px corner radius maximum, narrow light top edge and 3–5px lower bevel
Teal selected card outline plus a checkmark; semantic state is not conveyed by color alone
Solid recessed patches beneath body copy keep texture clear of small text
scope: Visual direction proposal only; no runtime source edits, new gameplay or benchmark implementation
gameplay: Keep existing cyan/coral team identities and territory meaning; do not recolor gameplay by cosmetic palette.
pending: Updated complete Inventory and Store mockups in the agreed scheme
Frozen benchmark target and acceptance scope
preview: Six canonical appearances in a responsive three-column grid, local select/equip and close/reopen behavior; repeated dimensional studs in all product background areas. A contained style sample, not a completed Inventory/Store benchmark.
browserQA: Static markup, source, selector and JavaScript syntax checks only; exact fonts embedded. No rendered browser QA claimed.
contrastMethod: Calculated solid sRGB foreground/background pairs only. Gradients, raised highlights and outlines also affect rendered appearance; native Studio and phone visual approval remains pending.
